theater: 北平西南盧溝橋與宛平城

battle.name: 盧溝橋
battle.theater: 北平西南盧溝橋與宛平城
battle.brief: 一九三七年七月七日夜，日軍在北平西南盧溝橋一帶夜間演習後藉端挑釁，炮擊宛平城，中國守軍應戰，衝突在十數日內擴為華北與上海兩戰場並行的全面抗戰。卡面這輛法製雷諾FT是現代戰車的原型，可旋轉砲塔確立了後來戰車的基本語法；當時華北前線雙方都沒有可用的裝甲，戰局只能靠步兵與砲兵消耗。

kit.name: 雷諾 FT
kit.history: 一戰量產輕戰車。可旋轉砲塔成為後來戰車的基本語法，而不是移動碉堡。

countries: 交戰一方是中國。抗戰全面爆發時的中央政府在南京，卻早已失去對華北的直接控制：一九三五年的《何梅協定》取消國民黨在華北的黨政機關，日本在冀東扶植自治政府，同年成立的冀察政務委員會把北平、天津、察哈爾的軍政權集中在一支地方軍隊手上。宋哲元同時是第二十九軍軍長，該軍轄第三十七師、第五十三師與第二一九師；宛平城與盧溝橋一線由第三十七師第一一二旅第二一九團與第二一九師一部駐守，豐臺另有日軍駐屯隊與鐵路守備隊。宛平城距北平城約二十公里，兩地之間的公路與電話線是全線的咽喉。另一方是日本。日本陸軍自一九三一年起以關東軍為主體經營中國東北，一九三七年北平的日軍由陸軍第一軍指揮，軍長香月清司，下轄駐天津的支那駐屯軍（司令官河邊正三）與第六師團一部；關東軍參謀部在石原莞爾、東條英機等人主導下策動華北的自治運動，並把北方的事變視為打通北進道路的機會。國際層面是三方觀望：英國正忙於歐洲的德國問題，美國奉行孤立主義，蘇聯在遠東既不願與日本直接衝突、也無力約束日本，《九國公約》與國際聯盟早已無法保障中國的地位，德義兩國則在歐洲供應日本的同時維持遠東的均勢。
countriesEn: One side of the conflict was China. The central government sat in Nanjing, yet it had already lost direct control of North China: the Ho-Mei Agreement of 1935 dissolved the Nationalist party and government organs in the region and Japan propped up an autonomy government in East Hebei, while the Zhili-Chahar Administrative Commission, set up in the same year, concentrated the military and civil authority of Beiping, Tianjin and Chahar in the hands of a provincial army. Song Zheyuan was at the same time commander of the 29th Army, which comprised the 37th, 53rd and 219th Divisions; the line of Wannping and Lugou Bridge was held by the 219th Regiment of the 112th Brigade, 37th Division, together with part of the 219th Division, while a Japanese garrison detachment and a railway guard unit sat at Fengtai. Wannping lay about twenty kilometres south-west of Beiping, and the road and telephone line between the two were the throat of the whole front. The other side was Japan. From 1931 the Japanese army, centred on the Kwantung Army, built its position in north-eastern China; in 1937 the Japanese forces in the north were under the First Army commanded by Seiji Katsuki, which controlled the China Garrison Army in Tianjin under Shōzō Kawabe and part of the 6th Division. The Kwantung Army staff, with Ishiwara Seijirō and Tōjō Hideki prominent in it, drove the autonomy movement in North China and treated trouble in the north as a stepping-stone to the northern route. Internationally three powers watched: Britain was absorbed by the European problem posed by Germany, the United States followed a policy of isolation, and the Soviet Union in the Far East neither wished to clash with Japan directly nor had the means to restrain it; the Nine-Power Treaty and the League of Nations no longer secured China's position, while Germany and Italy supplied Japan in Europe and at the same time held the balance in the Far East.
people: 中方一線的指揮權並不統一。宋哲元以冀察政務委員會委員長兼第二十九軍軍長的身分主持大局，是最高決策者；但實際指揮作戰的是前線的師長與團長：第二一九師師長趙登禹在平漢鐵路一線佈防，第三十七師第一一二旅第二一九團團長吉星文率部死守宛平城與橋頭，宛平縣縣長王冷燐依城垣同日軍交涉並組織城內防守。七月廿八日南苑失守，副軍長佟麟閣與師長趙登禹陣亡，宋哲元率部退往保定，第二十九軍的番號其後被取消，部隊分散編入各戰線序列。中央這邊，蔣介石在廬山發表講話確認全面抗戰，下令中央軍隊北上增援，並把政府遷往重慶；軍政部主持了部隊的擴編與補給安排；行政院仍在主戰與主和之間周旋。中共在七月召開國共合作會議，八月在洛川會議上通過抗日救國十大綱，主張停止內戰、武裝抗日；九月紅軍改編為國民革命軍第八路軍，朱德任總指揮、彭德懷任副總指揮，林彪率第一一五師在平型關一役中打擊日軍。日方的主導人物分在東京與關東軍兩地：首相近衛文麿、外相廣田弘毅主持閣議，陸軍第一軍軍長香月清司與駐屯軍司令官河邊正三在前線執行，關東軍參謀部則是推動升級的機關，參謀長東條英機主張把關東軍的北方計劃同華北的局勢連成一體。
peopleEn: The command on the Chinese side was not unified. Song Zheyuan, chairman of the Zhili-Chahar Administrative Commission and commander of the 29th Army, took the top decisions, but the fighting was actually directed by the divisional and regimental commanders in the line: Zhao Dengyu of the 219th Division held the railway front north of the city, Ji Xingwen, regimental commander of the 219th Regiment of the 112th Brigade, 37th Division, fought to hold Wannping and the bridgehead, and Wang Lenglin, magistrate of Wannping, dealt with the Japanese from the city wall and organised the defence inside. When Nanyuan fell on 28 July the vice-commander Tong Linge and the divisional commander Zhao Dengyu were killed in action, Song withdrew towards Baoding, and the designation of the 29th Army was later cancelled, its units distributed into the formations of other lines. At the centre, Chiang Kai-shek spoke at Lushan to confirm the full-scale war, ordered central troops north to reinforce the fighting and moved the seat of government to Chongqing; the War Ministry directed the expansion of the army and the arrangements for supply; the executive yuan still hovered between the war and peace factions. The Communist Party called the united front conference in July and adopted the Ten-Point Programme for National Salvation at the Luochuan conference in August, calling for an end to the civil war and for armed resistance; in September the Red Army was reorganised as the Eighth Route Army of the National Revolutionary Army, with Zhu De as commander-in-chief, Peng Dehuai as deputy, and Lin Biao leading the 115th Division in the action at Pingxingguan. On the Japanese side the leading figures were divided between Tokyo and the Kwantung Army: the prime minister Konoe Fumimaro and the foreign minister Hirota Kōki took the decisions in cabinet, General Seiji Katsuki of the First Army and Kawabe Shōzō of the Garrison Army carried them out at the front, and the Kwantung Army staff was the organ that pushed the escalation, its chief of staff Tōjō Hideki arguing for linking the northern plans of the Kwantung Army with the situation in North China.
kits: 卡面這輛雷諾FT是現代戰車的原型：一九一七年法國量產，乘員兩人，車重約二點一五噸，裝甲八至十五毫米，裝三十七毫米砲與七點五毫米機槍，公路最高時速約二十五至三十公里；真正改變戰車形態的是它的可旋轉砲塔，把火力指向與行走方向分開，此後各國的輕型戰車幾乎都沿用這套語法。一戰期間它與後續型號共生產四萬輛以上，是產量最大的戰車型號之一。在盧溝橋的體系裏，FT所代表的那一類裝甲並不存在：第二十九軍是純步兵部隊，只有步槍、機槍、迫擊砲、七五山砲、通訊器材與工兵器材；日軍在豐臺與北平周邊的駐屯部隊同樣是步兵與砲兵，沒有戰車。真正有裝甲的時刻在一九三八年徐州會戰：日軍把八九式中戰車投入隴海線作戰，中國方面也把英製六噸輕型戰車編成裝甲部隊，雙方在公路上面對面（此段各家戰史記載略有出入）。FT那一套設計真正落到中國戰場，是在三十年代後期蘇聯交付的BT-5與T-26，國民政府以之組成機械化第二百師，一九三八年之後在華中作戰。雙方其他裝備：中軍步槍以毛瑟系七九式與中正式為主，輕機槍為ZB-26型，重機槍為二七式，迫擊砲以八二迫擊砲為主；日軍以三八式步槍（六點五毫米）配擲彈筒、五十毫米曲射砲、七十五野砲與一零五榴彈砲，連射武器是每分鐘約五百發的輕機槍。守軍另有第二十九軍傳統的大刀，用於夜襲與破壞鐵絲網；通信靠架空電話線與軍馬，運輸以徵用民車、大車與鐵路為主，糧秣多就地徵集。
kitsEn: The Renault FT on the card is the archetype of the modern tank: mass-produced in France from 1917, it carried a crew of two, weighed about 2.15 tonnes, was protected by 8 to 15 millimetres of armour and mounted a 37 mm gun with a 7.5 mm machine gun, with a road speed of roughly 25 to 30 kilometres per hour. What really changed the form of the tank was its revolving turret, which separated the direction of fire from the direction of travel, and almost every light tank built afterwards followed that grammar. During the First World War the type and its successors were produced to a total of more than forty thousand vehicles, making it one of the most numerous tanks ever built. In the order of battle at Lugou Bridge the kind of armour the FT stood for did not exist: the 29th Army was a pure infantry force with rifles, machine guns, mortars, 75 mm mountain guns, communications equipment and engineer stores, and the Japanese garrison at Fengtai and around Beiping was likewise infantry and artillery without a tank. Armoured action came with the Xuzhou campaign of 1938, when the Japanese committed Type 89 medium tanks on the Longhai railway and the Chinese side formed a tank force from British six-ton light tanks, the two meeting face to face on a road (the various operational histories differ slightly on this action). The FT design itself reached the Chinese battlefield only with the Soviet BT-5 and T-26 delivered in the later 1930s, with which the Nationalist government formed the 200th Mechanised Division, committed in central China from 1938. The other equipment on both sides: the Chinese infantry carried Mauser-pattern Type 79 and Chiang Kai-shek rifles, the ZB-26 light machine gun, the Type 27 heavy machine gun and the 82 mm mortar; the Japanese used the Type 38 rifle in 6.5 mm with grenade dischargers, 50 mm trench mortars, 75 mm field guns and 105 mm howitzers, their automatic weapon being a light machine gun firing about five hundred rounds a minute. The defenders also had the Dadao, the great sword of the 29th Army, for night attacks and for cutting wire; communications ran on overhead telephone lines and army horses, transport on requisitioned carts and lorries and on the railways, and grain was largely collected locally.
tactics: 盧溝橋的戰鬥以夜戰為主。日軍在七月七日深夜藉夜間演習逼近城牆，以分遣隊搜索、機槍與擲彈筒封鎖橋面，隨即以炮擊迫使守軍開火；中國守軍依托宛平城牆的射擊孔與街壘，以機槍、迫擊砲與手榴彈還擊，天亮前雙方在橋頭反覆拉鋸。橋是整個陣地的關鍵：盧溝橋為十一孔石拱，全長不足三百米，橋面寬約十米，兩側石欄與橋墩把射界切成數段，進攻方必須逐次打通，防守方只要把火力集中到橋頭與南門就能反覆攔住。日軍的作法是白天用山砲與曲射砲壓制城頭射擊孔，夜晚以步兵小組滲透與襲擊消耗守軍，藉反覆的夜間演習與騷擾拖垮對手的警戒；守軍則派出小游擊隊破壞日軍的電話線與鐵絲網，消耗敵方的準備。戰術升級在七月下旬完成：日軍把一次橋頭衝突擴成對平津地區中國軍隊的攻擊，七月二十五日以後南苑方向的戰鬥同時展開，北平的城防與城郊的營地一起被壓；中國的應對是節節抵抗、轉入持久戰的佈局，七月二十日蔣介石在廬山講話確認全面抗戰後，華北與上海兩戰場同時開火。此後的戰術樣貌也隨之改變：正面是徐州會戰那樣的機動作戰與陣地戰，敵後則由八路軍展開游擊，鐵路與公路成為爭奪重點，而日軍在華北以「以戰養戰」與據點化的治安戰同游擊隊反覆拉鋸。
tacticsEn: The fighting at Lugou Bridge was fought mainly at night. On the night of 7 July the Japanese closed on the city wall under cover of a night exercise, sealing the bridge with search parties, machine guns and grenade dischargers, and then opened fire to force the defenders to shoot. The Chinese garrison answered from the firing slots of the Wannping wall and from street barricades with machine guns, mortars and grenades, and the two sides fought back and forth over the bridgehead before dawn. The bridge was the key to the position: Lugou Bridge is a stone bridge of eleven semicircular arches, less than three hundred metres long and about ten metres wide, and its parapets and piers cut the field of fire into short sectors, so an attacker had to open the way piecemeal, while the defenders, by concentrating fire on the bridgehead and the south gate, could stop the crossings again and again. The Japanese method was to use mountain and trench guns by day to suppress the firing slots of the wall and, at night, to wear the garrison down with infiltration and small attacks, using repeated night exercises and harassment to exhaust the enemy's watchfulness; the defenders sent out small parties to cut the Japanese telephone lines and wire and to consume the enemy's preparations. The escalation in tactics was completed in the last third of July: the Japanese turned a clash at the bridge into an attack on the Chinese forces across the Peiping-Tianjin area, the fighting at Nanyuan opened from 25 July, and the defences of the city and the camps outside it were pressed together. China's answer was to resist in stages and to lay out for a long war: after Chiang Kai-shek spoke at Lushan on 20 July and confirmed the full-scale war, North China and Shanghai became two fronts burning at once. The shape of the fighting changed accordingly. On the front it was the mobile and positional warfare of the Xuzhou campaign; behind the lines the Eighth Route Army opened a war of raids, the railways and roads became the points of contention, and in North China the Japanese fought the raiders with a warfare of supply by conquest and a network of fortified posts.
data: 時間：事變起於一九三七年七月七日深夜，橋頭的零星交火持續數日，七月二十五日後戰火擴至南苑與平津全境，七月二十八日北平失守，七月二十九日冀察政務委員會解散。兵力：宛平城與橋頭一線的中國守軍在數千人規模，常見記載為數個營的番號，各家統計不一；日軍最初投入的是數百人，一個步兵中隊與分遣隊的規模，其後由天津與北平周邊增援。中國方面的總體規模是抗戰全面爆發時陸軍師番號近二百個、總兵力約二百萬，華北由第二十九軍三個師與中央軍一部擔任；第二十九軍番號於一九三七年秋取消。武器數據：中軍制式步槍中正式口徑七點九毫米，槍重約四公斤，彈匣五發，有效射程約六百米；三八式步槍口徑六點五毫米，槍重約四點一公斤，同樣五發彈匣，有效射程約五百米，兩國口徑不同，彈藥不能互通。ZB-26輕機槍口徑七點九二毫米，三十發彈匣，有效射程五百至八百米，每分鐘約五百發；日軍輕機槍亦約五百發。砲兵方面，中軍以七五山砲與八二迫擊砲為骨幹，日軍有七十五野砲、五十曲射砲與一零五榴彈砲。裝備數據：雷諾FT車重約二點一五噸，裝甲八至十五毫米，裝三十七毫米砲與七點五毫米機槍，公路時速約二十五至三十公里，一戰總產量逾四萬輛，具體數字各家統計略有出入。地理與後續：宛平城在北平西南約二十公里，豐臺在其東南數公里，兩地由鐵路支線相連，北平南苑機場距城約十公里。其後的日程是：一九三七年八月十三日夜上海開戰，九月二十五日平型關戰鬥，十月太原會戰，十二月九日中國宣戰，十二月十三日南京失守；一九三八年三月蘭封方向的公路戰是中國裝甲部隊與日軍八九式中戰車首次交鋒；一九四五年八月十五日日本宣布接受《波茨坦宣言》，九月二日於東京灣「密蘇里」號簽署投降書，九月三日定為中國人民抗日戰爭勝利紀念日。
dataEn: Timing: the incident began on the night of 7 July 1937, sporadic firing at the bridgehead continued for several days, from 25 July the flames spread to Nanyuan and to the whole of the Peiping-Tianjin area, Beiping fell on 28 July, and the Zhili-Chahar Administrative Commission was dissolved on 29 July. Manpower: the Chinese garrison at Wannping and the bridgehead was on the order of several thousand men, usually given as a number of battalion-sized units, and the counts differ between sources; the Japanese initially committed several hundred men, a battalion and detachments, with reinforcements arriving afterwards from Tianjin and the Beiping area. On the Chinese side the overall scale was a near two hundred divisional establishments and about two million men in the army when the full war began, of which North China was the responsibility of the three divisions of the 29th Army and part of the central army; the designation of the 29th Army was cancelled in the autumn of 1937. Weapons: the standard Chinese rifle, the Chiang Kai-shek rifle, was 7.9 mm, weighed about four kilograms, held five rounds and had an effective range of about six hundred metres; the Type 38 rifle was 6.5 mm, weighed about 4.1 kilograms, also held five rounds and had an effective range of about five hundred metres, the two calibres differing so that ammunition could not be shared. The ZB-26 light machine gun was 7.92 mm with a thirty-round magazine, an effective range of five hundred to eight hundred metres and a rate of fire of about five hundred rounds a minute, the Japanese light machine gun being of a similar rate. In the artillery the Chinese relied on 75 mm mountain guns and 82 mm mortars, the Japanese on 75 mm field guns, 50 mm trench mortars and 105 mm howitzers. Equipment: the Renault FT weighed about 2.15 tonnes with 8 to 15 millimetres of armour, mounted a 37 mm gun and a 7.5 mm machine gun, and reached about 25 to 30 kilometres per hour on roads; more than forty thousand were built during the First World War, the exact totals varying a little between authorities. Geography and what followed: Wannping lay about twenty kilometres south-west of Beiping, Fengtai lay a few kilometres to its south-east, the two were joined by a branch railway, and the Nanyuan airfield stood about ten kilometres from the city. The diary that followed reads: Shanghai went to war on the night of 13 August 1937; the action at Pingxingguan was fought on 25 September; the Taiyuan campaign was fought in October; China declared war on 9 December; Nanking fell on 13 December. In March 1938 a road action in the Lanfeng direction was the first meeting between Chinese armoured units and Japanese Type 89 medium tanks; on 15 August 1945 Japan announced its acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration, the instrument of surrender was signed aboard the Missouri in Tokyo Bay on 2 September, and 3 September was fixed as the Victory Day of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression.
cause: 遠因是日本的大陸政策。一九三一年九一八事變之後，日本取得中國東北；一九三三年進佔熱河並突破長城各口；一九三五年的《何梅協定》逼走國民黨在華北的黨政機關，日本在冀東扶植自治政府，同年《塘沽協定》又把察哈爾與河北的一部分權力交給冀察的半自治體制。一九三六年，日本在華北推動所謂「自治運動」，要求軍事、財政、教育人事一體自治，並在十一月以關東軍支援的偽蒙軍進攻綏遠，傅作義所部在百靈廟迎擊並將其擊退。一九三六年十二月西安事變是關鍵的轉折：蔣介石被扣，內戰停止，中共居間促成和平解決，中國國內的重心轉向一致抗日；關東軍擔心中國統一之後轉而對日作戰，反而加快在華北製造事端，同時對南京伸出誘惑之手，蔣在年底向廣田弘毅表示願與日本改善關係，仍未換來日方收手。結構上的原因是華北的權力真空：冀察政務委員會夾在中央與日本之間，宋哲元的第二十九軍既要防範日本，也要聽命於南京，雙方的電報往返在七月裡一再延宕反應的時間。國際上，歐洲的局勢吸走英國的注意力，蘇聯在遠東避免兩面作戰，國際聯盟對日本已無約束力，沒有一個機制能攔住七月七日夜的炮聲。直接導火索是七月七日深夜：日軍在宛平城附近實施夜間演習，藉口一名士兵失蹤，要求進城搜查，守軍拒絕，日軍隨即炮擊宛平城，中國守軍還擊，一場小規模衝突就此打開。
causeEn: The distant cause was the continental policy of Japan. After the Mukden incident of 18 September 1931 Japan held north-eastern China; in 1933 it occupied Jehol and broke through the Great Wall passes; the Ho-Mei Agreement of 1935 drove the Nationalist party and government organs out of North China and Japan propped up an autonomy government in East Hebei, while the Tanggu Truce of the same year handed part of the authority over Chahar and Hebei to the semi-autonomous regime in Zhili and Chahar. In 1936 Japan pressed the so-called autonomy movement in North China, demanding autonomy for the military, the finances, the schools and the personnel, and in November sent troops of a Mongol puppet army supported by the Kwantung Army against Suiyuan, where Fu Zuoyi's troops met them at Bailingmiao and beat them back. The Xi'an incident of December 1936 was the crucial turning point: Chiang Kai-shek was detained, the civil war stopped, the Communist Party brokered a peaceful settlement, and the weight of Chinese politics turned to a united resistance. Fearing a united China that would one day fight Japan, the Kwantung Army accelerated its provocations in North China while at the same time sounding out Nanjing; Chiang's end-of-year message to Hirota Kōki, offering to improve relations with Japan, bought no restraint. The structural cause was the vacuum of authority in North China. The Zhili-Chahar Administrative Commission stood between the central government and Japan, and Song Zheyuan's 29th Army had to hold off Japan while also obeying Nanjing, the exchange of telegrams in July repeatedly delaying the response. Abroad, the situation in Europe absorbed Britain's attention, the Soviet Union avoided a war on two fronts in the Far East, the League of Nations had no hold on Japan, and no mechanism stood in the way of the guns fired on the night of 7 July. The immediate occasion was that night itself: a Japanese night exercise near Wannping produced a demand to enter the city to search for a soldier said to be missing; the garrison refused; the Japanese opened fire on the city; the Chinese returned the fire, and a small clash was set loose.
impact: 盧溝橋事件的第一重影響，是把一次地方衝突變成國家的戰爭：中華民國進入全面抗戰，中國戰場成為第二次世界大戰在亞洲的主要戰場之一，遠東的國際秩序也正式崩解，《九國公約》體系只剩下形式。第二重影響在國內政治與軍事上：一九三七年九月蔣介石發表談話、中共中央發表合作宣言，紅軍改編為國民革命軍第八路軍，第一一五、第一二〇、第一二九三個師編入正面戰線序列，同時深入敵後；平型關一役之後，敵後游擊戰成為一條與正面戰場並行的長期戰線，抗戰的樣貌從會戰變成會戰與游擊並存。華北的防線在半年內崩解，日軍在佔領區以「以戰養戰」維持補給，沿鐵路與公路修築據點並實施「囚籠政策」，國民政府的正面部隊退守黃河與淮河流域。第三重影響落在日本的戰略選擇上：關東軍多年力推的北進方案因中國戰場的長期消耗而被擱置，一九三八年十一月的御前會議決定不對蘇聯動用武力，日本轉而向南方取決，一九四一年十二月偷襲珍珠港；美國在一九三九年廢除《美日通商航海條約》並對日輸出管制，中蘇之間的關係也在一九三七年之後明顯靠攏。第四重影響是記憶的形式：七月七日成為國家記憶中的日期，宛平城上的盧溝橋事變碑於同年豎立，一九八七年七月七日中國人民抗日戰爭紀念館在宛平城落成開放。
impactEn: The first effect of the Lugou Bridge incident was to turn a local clash into a national war. The Republic of China entered the full-scale war, the Chinese battlefield became one of the principal theatres of the Second World War in Asia, and the international order of the Far East collapsed in form, the Nine-Power Treaty system surviving as nothing more than an appearance. The second effect was domestic and military. In September 1937 Chiang Kai-shek spoke and the Central Committee of the Communist Party published the declaration of co-operation; the Red Army was reorganised as the Eighth Route Army of the National Revolutionary Army, and the 115th, 120th and 129th Divisions entered the sequence of the front line formations while pushing deep into the enemy rear. After the action at Pingxingguan the war behind the lines became a long parallel front, and the character of the war changed from set-piece battle to battles and raids existing together. The defensive line in North China came apart within half a year; in the occupied areas the Japanese maintained their supply by conquest, built posts along the railways and roads and applied what was called the cage policy, while the Nationalist formations on the front fell back to the Yellow and Huai valleys. The third effect fell on Japanese strategy. The northern scheme the Kwantung Army had pushed for years was set aside because of the long drain of the Chinese battlefield; an imperial conference in November 1938 decided not to use force against the Soviet Union, Japan turned to the south instead, and in December 1941 struck Pearl Harbor. The United States abrogated the American-Japanese Treaty of Commerce and Navigation in 1939 and applied export controls, and Soviet-Chinese relations drew noticeably closer after 1937. The fourth effect took the form of memory. The seventh of July became a date in the national memory, the stele of the Marco Polo Bridge incident was raised on the wall of Wannping in that same year, and on 7 July 1987 the Chinese People's War of Resistance Museum was opened to the public at Wannping.
result: 盧溝橋本身的結局，是局部衝突沒有局部收場。守軍在宛平城與橋頭抵抗數日之後，仍未能保住北平：七月二十五日以後日軍攻擊南苑等處，七月二十八日南苑失守，副軍長佟麟閣與第二一九師師長趙登禹陣亡，宋哲元率部西撤，七月二十九日冀察政務委員會解散，北平落入日軍之手，第二十九軍的番號取消，所部分散編入其他序列，宛平城與盧溝橋的守備改由日軍與偽軍接替。但戰爭從此按全面規模進行：七月二十日蔣介石在廬山講話中確認抗戰，八月十三日夜上海開戰，十月太原會戰，十一月政府遷都重慶，十二月九日中國正式宣戰，十二月十三日南京失守，華北與華中兩線同時吃緊。日軍在華北佔領區以「以戰養戰」維持遠距離消耗，兵力被長期釘在中國；一九四二年緬甸戰役失利後，雲南通往印度的援華通道被切斷，外援只能改走駝峰航線。直到一九四五年八月十五日日本宣布接受《波茨坦宣言》，九月二日在東京灣「密蘇里」號戰艦上簽署投降書，九月三日定為中國人民抗日戰爭勝利紀念日，十月二十五日臺灣受降，戰爭才算結束。對軍隊本身而言，這場戰爭改變了兩個國家的軍隊：中國陸軍由裝備落後、缺乏統一補給的步兵部隊，逐步整編成能作機動作戰、能打游擊戰並維持遠方戰線的現代軍隊；日本則在中國戰場累積了龐大的佔領軍與後方部隊，最終在兩線作戰與本土轟炸之下失去作戰能力。對兵器而言，一九三八年之後出現在中國戰場上的那些可旋轉砲塔輕型戰車，正是FT所確立的語法。
resultEn: The local outcome at Lugou Bridge was that a local clash had no local ending. After the garrison had resisted at Wannping and the bridgehead for several days it could not hold Beiping: from 25 July the Japanese attacked at Nanyuan and elsewhere, Nanyuan fell on 28 July, the vice-commander Tong Linge and the 219th Division commander Zhao Dengyu were killed, Song Zheyuan withdrew westwards, and on 29 July the Zhili-Chahar Administrative Commission was dissolved. Beiping passed into Japanese hands, the designation of the 29th Army was cancelled and its units scattered into other formations, and the garrison of Wannping and the bridge was taken over by Japanese and puppet troops. But the war now ran at full scale: Chiang Kai-shek confirmed the resistance in his speech at Lushan on 20 July, Shanghai went to war on the night of 13 August, the Taiyuan campaign was fought in October, the government moved to Chongqing in November, China declared war on 9 December, Nanking fell on 13 December, and North China and central China were both under strain. In the occupied areas of North China the Japanese kept up a distant war of attrition by conquest, their strength pinned down in China for years; after the loss of Burma in 1942 the road to India through Yunnan was cut and outside supplies had to travel by the Hump route. The war did not end until 15 August 1945, when Japan announced its acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration, and until the instrument of surrender was signed aboard the Missouri in Tokyo Bay on 2 September, with 3 September fixed as the Victory Day of the Chinese People's War of Resistance and Taiwan taken over on 25 October. For the armed forces themselves the war changed two armies. The Chinese army, poorly equipped and short of a unified supply system, was progressively reorganised into a modern force able to fight mobile operations, to fight a war of raids and to hold distant fronts; the Japanese accumulated enormous garrisons and rear-area forces in China and finally lost the capacity to fight under the strain of two fronts and the bombing of the home islands. In the matter of weapons, the light tanks with revolving turrets that appeared on the Chinese battlefield after 1938 spoke exactly the grammar the FT had established.
